Before you go

Good questions.
Clear answers.

The desert is more comfortable when expectations are clear. Your guide handles the technical equipment and route decisions; you arrive ready to move, learn, and spend the day outside.

01Do I need prior canyoneering experience?

No. Several routes are designed for first-time guests, and your guide teaches each step before you use it. We’ll help experienced guests choose a route with more challenge.

02What should I bring?

Closed-toe footwear, sun protection, water, snacks, and layers suited to the forecast. Trip-specific equipment and a complete packing note follow booking.

03Are these trips private?

This concept emphasizes a private-guide experience so the pace and route can reflect your group. Confirm the current trip format when selecting your date.

04What happens if weather changes the plan?

Canyon weather can change route access. The guide evaluates current conditions and recommends a safe alternative when needed.
